depth: The depth map depicts an indoor lounge arrangement with the camera wearer seated and their own legs, a pink tote bag at the lower left, and a small open case at the lower right all lying within arm's reach, approximately 0.3 to 0.8 metres away. A blue-jacketed person in dark trousers stands directly ahead at about 1.5 to 2.0 metres, facing the camera wearer, while someone seated at the far right is around 1.0 to 1.5 metres distant and roughly 1.0 metre to the standing person's right. Through the five frames, the camera wearer's right arm extends forward and upward in frame 1 (the brightest white, ~0.2–0.4 m), angles down toward the pink bag in frame 2 while the bag dominates the foreground at ~0.3–0.5 metres, lifts once more in frame 3 as the camera pitches upward, and drops in frames 4 and 5 while the standing person holds a phone slightly nearer to the camera wearer. More clearly than the cluttered RGB view alone, the depth map distinguishes the foreground arm reach and tote bag from the mid-ground standing person and from the background coffee table (~2.5 m) and walls (>3.5 m). Nevertheless, it is unreliable within the dark open interiors of the bag and case, where the depth becomes flat, and it discards detail from the background windows and walls, which blend together as uniform black.
segmentation: The instance segmentation view detects the foreground pink tote bag (classified as 'suitcase' or 'backpack') on the lower left at 0.4 to 0.7 metres, the central standing person at 1.5 to 2.0 metres, the camera wearer's lifted right arm and legs on the lower right within 0.3 to 0.6 metres, and partly visible seated people along the far left and right borders at 1.0 to 2.0 metres. From frames 3 through 5, the standing person's upper body—facing forward, cut off at the top edge, and with the head outside the view—stays behind the bag and case in the lower foreground, while the seated person on the right holds a small item labeled 'remote' within their own arm's reach (~0.3 m from their body) and turns slightly toward the center. Its categories and coverage are unreliable, however: the soft pink tote and small drone/device case are incorrectly called 'suitcase' or 'backpack,' including overlapping text reading 'suitcasek'; in frame 3 it joins the camera wearer's arm with the seated neighbour on the right; and it entirely fails to detect both the standing person's phone in frame 5 and the background coffee table.
pose: The skeleton display follows 2D joint and finger locations across the upper-middle and right areas of the scene, marking the standing person's torso and arms at 1.5 to 2.0 metres in frames 3 and 4 and the camera wearer's right hand within 0.4 metres in frames 2 and 3. In frame 2, a magenta hand skeleton traces the camera wearer's right fingers as they grasp the pink bag's upper right rim. In frame 3, that hand is lifted in front of the view's right side, while the standing person's yellow torso and upper-arm skeleton is visible above and behind the bag, oriented directly toward the camera wearer with both hands together at chest level (~1.5 m away). During frame 4, the standing person's shoulder-and-torso box and grouped magenta finger joints stay centered at chest height as they hold a phone within their own arm's reach; their head remains cropped beyond the frame's top edge. The map exposes precise finger articulation and the standing person's bilateral shoulder alignment, as well as the camera wearer's reaching hand, all of which are partly motion-blurred or visually obscured by clothing in the RGB images. Even so, pose detection is extremely sparse and unreliable across the sequence: it finds no skeletons whatsoever in frames 1 and 5, leaves out the standing person's legs in every frame, and entirely misses the seated individuals at both the left and right edges.
